title: Wire the four reachable agent-answer and context-broker suites by named file; keep the two unreachable renders out

scope.judgedWhole: Every test file in both directories is a row. Once four of six run, both directories are PARTIAL and leave the dark-directory ratchet's set, so that ratchet can no longer see a seventh file added beside them. The control pins the on-disk file set of each directory to this record in its place.
scope.everyFileWasExecuted: Each file was run on its own with `npx jest --runTestsByPath <file> --no-coverage --ci` on the base: 6 of 6 green.

wiring.step: Run the T-780 agent-answer and context-broker suites by named file
wiring.whyByFile: Naming either directory would also select AvaAsk.test.tsx or FourModeDemoSurface.test.tsx, which render components no route reaches (T-775).

ratchet.question: How does the dark-directory ratchet treat a directory that becomes PARTIAL?
ratchet.answer: It drops it. The ratchet's set is the census's `uncoveredDirectories`, which holds only directories with zero covered files. A directory with one covered file moves to `partiallyCoveredDirectories`, so both lines leave `product-directory-ci-coverage.baseline.json` (126 -> 124) and the ratchet's set equality stays exact. Measured, not inferred: the ratchet suite was run against the edited baseline and passed with nothing entering and exactly these two leaving.
ratchet.whatReplacesIt: After this change the ratchet says nothing about these two directories. `t780-named-file-wiring.test.ts` asserts each directory's on-disk test files equal this record's rows, that every held row is reached by no merge-blocking invocation, and that each held row still renders a component the unreachable register lists.

assetCaseDecision.decision: Wired in the same named-file step, not moved to an asset validator.
assetCaseDecision.reason: It reads two SVGs under public/brand/ava and asserts their fill colours. Those bytes are what AvaAskMark serves by URL, so the text is the shipped artifact rather than a stand-in for behaviour, and a comment in source code cannot satisfy it. No asset validator covers public/brand/ava today (the brand checks under src/__tests__/integration name other paths), so moving the case would mean building new infrastructure for one assertion. The control recomputes this rather than trusting the row: every file the suite reads must sit under public/, and AvaAskMark.tsx must reference each one by its served URL, and AvaAskMark must not be on the unreachable register.

heldFiles.src/components/agent-answer/__tests__/Av: Renders AvaAsk, listed in docs/architecture/unreachable-components.json. T-775 owns retire-or-mount.
heldFiles.src/components/context-broker/__tests__/: Renders FourModeDemoSurface, listed in docs/architecture/unreachable-components.json. T-775 owns retire-or-mount.

forbiddenEdits: No suite file in either directory was edited. AvaAsk.test.tsx and FourModeDemoSurface.test.tsx are T-775's decision.
